why: Rework audit 2026-11-01: of 28 pieces of work that day none was moved from its older owner, 8 rewrote an owner that already did the job and 10 left a second live copy, because nothing refused a rewrite and a session that sees only one repository could not see the old owner. Every engine source file a change adds, or grows past grown_lines_over lines, is claimed by a contract in ports/: a SOURCE_FIRST_PORT or BEHAVIORAL_PORT (a port from another language) of the older owner, named by repository, commit and path, whose old copy leaves within old_copy_days_at_most days; or NO_PRIOR_OWNER with the search that found none, which the judge runs again. engine-feature-boundary.json stays the refusal of a new feature in the engine; this judges how admitted code arrived. The judge is the Workshop tool tools/check-a-port-against-its-source; it runs from the check row in the person's check lists at every commit and push, with the repositories a search must cover and the capability search.
